### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>withastro/astro (astro)</summary>

### [`v7.3.3`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/blob/HEAD/packages/astro/CHANGELOG.md#733)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/compare/astro@7.3.2...astro@7.3.3)

##### Patch Changes

- [#​17651](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17651) [`504333c`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/504333c2a0c7da3ca06e39ce37eee832192ba8ea) Thanks [@​sxzz](https://redirect.github.com/sxzz)! - Refactors internal version handling to use a smaller, ESM-native dependency

- [#​17942](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17942) [`0bc5715`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/0bc5715a2990a84598a064ac8de52c08fffd1186) Thanks [@​matthewp](https://redirect.github.com/matthewp)! - Returns appropriate 400 and 404 responses from the image endpoint for invalid and missing local image paths

- [#​17700](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17700) [`b2222fc`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/b2222fc3cdbeb1b75029a109d13d19515e5260ae) Thanks [@​winklemad](https://redirect.github.com/winklemad)! - Fixes `Astro.preferredLocaleList` returning an empty list when a locale is configured with the object form (`{ path, codes }`) and the browser sends the code with different casing or an underscore, such as `en-US` matching a configured `en-us`

- [#​17941](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17941) [`394ff79`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/394ff79954e5822e3884947a07d84fef0c72f31c) Thanks [@​matthewp](https://redirect.github.com/matthewp)! - Fixes `astro preview --ignore-lock` (and `astro dev --ignore-lock`) being refused when run from an AI agent environment. The flag now starts the server in the foreground instead of erroring, since agent detection only inferred background mode and was never explicitly requested. An explicit `--background` combined with `--ignore-lock` still errors.

- [#​17928](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17928) [`3277927`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/327792719475cf5b0023dd8983cfd0dc58070888) Thanks [@​ArmandPhilippot](https://redirect.github.com/ArmandPhilippot)! - Fixes TypeScript autocompletion for `getImage()` to suggest all available predefined options.

- [#​17928](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17928) [`3277927`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/327792719475cf5b0023dd8983cfd0dc58070888) Thanks [@​ArmandPhilippot](https://redirect.github.com/ArmandPhilippot)! - Fixes a type error in `getImage()` options that allowed passing both `widths` and `densities` at the same time.

- [#​17857](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17857) [`2637ed1`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/2637ed10afd26f1f29db673616c6225eb0d848a6) Thanks [@​Princesseuh](https://redirect.github.com/Princesseuh)! - Improves rendering performance

- [#​17943](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17943) [`2fc7ce9`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/2fc7ce98f982f45533d91b6ba5b95fce4eb54e11) Thanks [@​matthewp](https://redirect.github.com/matthewp)! - Fixes a WebAssembly error when importing `astro:actions` in tests that run under `@cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers`

- [#​18018](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18018) [`1b5a234`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/1b5a234f5205995ff3a1c7707c093e49f1f601e7) Thanks [@​astro-factory](https://redirect.github.com/apps/astro-factory)! - Fixes trailing-slash redirect response body pointing to the incoming URL instead of the redirect target. The `location` header was correct, but the HTML body (`<meta http-equiv="refresh">`, `<title>`, and `<a>` tag) contained the original request path without the trailing-slash correction or query string.

- [#​17905](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17905) [`eaf70fa`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/eaf70fa3f0b5d01237d9af8110649ded2e239b5d) Thanks [@​SudoDevStudio](https://redirect.github.com/SudoDevStudio)! - Fixes custom dev toolbar apps losing their UI after client-side navigation with `<ClientRouter />`.

- [#​18011](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18011) [`558b301`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/558b301a3626e5f0fd3ae4e3997e0c6de53e9867) Thanks [@​astro-factory](https://redirect.github.com/apps/astro-factory)! - Fixes prerendered Cloudflare pages rendering as `[object Object]` when `nodejs_compat` is enabled in `wrangler.toml`

- [#​17944](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17944) [`ba08e35`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/ba08e35fdc306219b69428e3e1c4e5816e116956) Thanks [@​matthewp](https://redirect.github.com/matthewp)! - Fixes a regression in `astro dev` where writes outside the module graph (for example, `@astrojs/cloudflare`'s `.wrangler/state` files) invalidated the middleware on every request, causing repeated SSR reloads. Such writes no longer invalidate the middleware.

- [#​17531](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17531) [`ae837db`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/ae837dbc692ba831ab9cc5bfebef403d72980ca0) Thanks [@​danilloestrela](https://redirect.github.com/danilloestrela)! - Updates `svgo` to `4.0.2` to resolve a security advisory

- [#​17953](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17953) [`dbbf10e`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/dbbf10e606f64b4ba2b8362868b6a27a9a937eb8) Thanks [@​astro-factory](https://redirect.github.com/apps/astro-factory)! - Fixes a one-time page reload shortly after the first load on cold dev-server starts when a project has framework components imported from MDX content entries. MDX files are now included in the dev dependency pre-bundling scan, so their framework dependencies are bundled up front instead of being discovered (and reloaded for) at runtime.

- [#​17955](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17955) [`4e8ad9a`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/4e8ad9a40affe6ae0a6c268a2100a203415479b6) Thanks [@​matthewp](https://redirect.github.com/matthewp)! - Improves dev server startup time. The content config and dev server app module graphs now begin compiling during server creation without blocking the server from listening. Request handling waits for the shared setup result when needed, cutting `astro dev` ready time by roughly a third on projects with a content config.

- [#​17960](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17960) [`9838049`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/98380490cef49418770102829f160942051a65b9) Thanks [@​Chy-Zaber-Bin-Zahid](https://redirect.github.com/Chy-Zaber-Bin-Zahid)! - Improves the diagnostics of some Astro errors.

- [#​17998](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17998) [`0e5478d`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/0e5478dff592653f3fa72ad51a38915648e4e8ad) Thanks [@​astro-factory](https://redirect.github.com/apps/astro-factory)! - Fixes SVG `<style>` elements nested inside `<defs>` or other container elements not being hashed for CSP

- [#​17994](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17994) [`80f9f1d`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/80f9f1d5364329de9ee97ef48d42fefe8535d2ef) Thanks [@​astro-factory](https://redirect.github.com/apps/astro-factory)! - Fixes `experimental.incrementalBuild` restoring pages with stale CSS after a preprocessor partial changes or missing original images referenced by restored pages

- [#​17889](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17889) [`8ae6b46`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/8ae6b4669c6543212d8384f883c33a4d50451aaa) Thanks [@​ajfAfg](https://redirect.github.com/ajfAfg)! - Fixes a bug where the dev server stripped the configured `base` from URLs that only share a prefix with it. With `base: '/s'`, requests to `/src/...` were rewritten to `/rc/...` and failed, breaking those pages during development.

- [#​17980](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17980) [`cfccafa`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/cfccafa9506250832b659b6c5c62c85ce081aee5) Thanks [@​gameroman](https://redirect.github.com/gameroman)! - Improves JSDoc for fonts api

- [#​17953](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17953) [`dbbf10e`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/dbbf10e606f64b4ba2b8362868b6a27a9a937eb8) Thanks [@​astro-factory](https://redirect.github.com/apps/astro-factory)! - Fixes CSS HMR for framework components rendered through content entries after `ClientRouter` navigation

- [#​17970](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17970) [`0b4dc3a`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/0b4dc3a211910b589d3805ab4dfedf11b0e712bb) Thanks [@​matthewp](https://redirect.github.com/matthewp)! - Improves serialization of transition animation values in generated CSS

- [#​17999](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17999) [`30ef3cb`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/30ef3cbb76550d45ec59e6c3201544df859c997a) Thanks [@​astro-factory](https://redirect.github.com/apps/astro-factory)! - Fixes content collection HMR not updating prerendered pages when an adapter enables a separate prerender environment (e.g. `@astrojs/cloudflare` with `prerenderEnvironment: 'node'`)

- [#​18002](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18002) [`312ab49`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/312ab49544eed1220453ed86c40896f49e31c7a9) Thanks [@​shoutoutuoadi325](https://redirect.github.com/shoutoutuoadi325)! - Fixes redirect targets being corrupted when a dynamic route parameter value contains `$` replacement patterns like `$&`

- [#​17937](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17937) [`e294953`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/e294953aa8aadd98d5be92e60a03037b05dbdfd4) Thanks [@​matthewp](https://redirect.github.com/matthewp)! - Fixes a bug where the `glob()` content loader kept stale entries in the data store after the last file in a collection was deleted. Empty collections are now pruned correctly, and the file watcher is registered in dev so the first file added to an empty collection is picked up without a restart.

- [#​17945](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17945) [`750b4db`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/750b4dbe238f2a2b979503ffd780f46d19174ccb) Thanks [@​matthewp](https://redirect.github.com/matthewp)! - Pre-bundles renderer server entrypoints and the default console logger during dev so they are included in the initial optimization pass, preventing a mid-request re-optimization that could crash the dev server on Cloudflare (workerd).

</details>

### Release Notes

<details>

### [`v7.3.4`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/blob/HEAD/packages/astro/CHANGELOG.md#734)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/compare/astro@7.3.3...astro@7.3.4)

##### Patch Changes

- [#​18063](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18063) [`40896ac`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/40896acb744988d9d3c2015e810c57de26390b3f) Thanks [@​adamchal](https://redirect.github.com/adamchal)! - Fixes incremental builds repeatedly rendering unchanged pages when modules or compiled CSS reference bundled assets.

- [#​18053](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18053) [`cf5d72f`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/cf5d72f286c3c1185b7d39692b8ca8e789c16e02) Thanks [@​Princesseuh](https://redirect.github.com/Princesseuh)! - Improves the `astro check` error shown for TypeScript 7. The command now explains that TypeScript 7 is not currently supported and provides instructions for experimentally type-checking Astro files with TypeScript 7.1 and `@astrojs/ts-content-mapper`.

- [#​18086](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18086) [`795a7e4`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/795a7e44640e7ad513a590a362dc0d3259de7771) Thanks [@​ump45nose](https://redirect.github.com/ump45nose)! - Fix double-escaped ampersands in Markdown image `alt` and `title` attributes. The `__ASTRO_IMAGE_` round-trip now decodes the numeric (`&`) and named (`&`) character references the Markdown processors emit, so an `&` in an alt or title is escaped exactly once in the final HTML instead of twice.

- [#​18074](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18074) [`0429805`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/042980585a75a12f3b0d63377483af98ef80e0f9) Thanks [@​SurefireStudios](https://redirect.github.com/SurefireStudios)! - Fix three error names that did not match their documented reference. `MissingLocale`, `MissingIndexForInternationalization` and `NoManifestAvailable` reported names ending in `Error` in the dev overlay, while their error reference pages are published under the unsuffixed names, so the name shown to users could not be found in the docs.

- [#​18007](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18007) [`2245837`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/22458379f5f258ac1df225f5af644b98b1b8237b) Thanks [@​L4XB](https://redirect.github.com/L4XB)! - Fixes the dev server re-evaluating the whole server module graph on every request. The `astro:head-metadata` plugin invalidated its component metadata virtual module from its own `transform` hook, so each evaluation of that module scheduled the next one. Adapters that run requests outside Vite's module runner, such as `@astrojs/cloudflare`, paid for a full re-evaluation of the server graph on every request for the lifetime of the process.

- [#​18096](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18096) [`43657c4`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/43657c4612f04cecf6e34d288eed1811c6508b74) Thanks [@​matthewp](https://redirect.github.com/matthewp)! - Fixes domain-based i18n routing to respect `security.allowedDomains` when selecting a locale from request host headers

- [#​18043](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18043) [`8a53a8b`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/8a53a8b70f964e7bc127d6991cc9aca21e87750f) Thanks [@​astro-factory](https://redirect.github.com/apps/astro-factory)! - Fixes `image.responsiveStyles` emitting invalid `object-position` CSS values for same-axis keyword pairs (`top bottom`, `left right`, etc.)

- [#​18029](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18029) [`c08252d`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/c08252d6803d4af2890b4bd1c69e4b4fc49e2d04) Thanks [@​matthewp](https://redirect.github.com/matthewp)! - Runs `astro dev` and `astro preview` in the foreground when an AI agent is detected on Windows, allowing the agent to manage the process lifetime. Pass `--background` explicitly to request an Astro-managed background process. Agent-inferred backgrounding remains enabled on other platforms.

- Updated dependencies \[[`3fd16ee`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/3fd16eeb5cd096a6ceb8cc3e70b89ed30d6fcd4d), [`8358d59`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/8358d59cba754480c7d830c473837a0d7100ac7e)]:
  - [@​astrojs/markdown-satteri](https://redirect.github.com/astrojs/markdown-satteri)@​0.4.2

##### Patch Changes

- [#​18266](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18266) [`cba76cc`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/cba76cc8200890186acf26444d473ebac0fc2623) Thanks [@​astro-factory](https://redirect.github.com/apps/astro-factory)! - Fixes a build error when a Markdown content collection entry loaded with `glob({ deferRender: true })` has a `layout` frontmatter property. `layout` is now ignored for content collection entries, as documented.

- [#​18287](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18287) [`38f6793`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/38f6793291ea01a13cf4e51a83aeb16966a5a495) Thanks [@​astro-factory](https://redirect.github.com/apps/astro-factory)! - Fixes `astro add cloudflare` failing to install dependencies with pnpm v11+ by approving the `workerd` build script, and shows the package manager's error output when `astro add` fails to install dependencies

- [#​18222](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18222) [`fcf6ed6`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/fcf6ed6d4915eed6c18a20658b73372d074c4832) Thanks [@​mingjunlu](https://redirect.github.com/mingjunlu)! - Fixes an issue where AVIF images were served as `image/heif` instead of `image/avif` in the dev server.

It now renders the custom 404 page, matching `astro()`.

- [#​18164](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18164) [`1a6997f`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/1a6997f280529650e4f1dacf0388e8fe07d05a1a) Thanks [@​astro-factory](https://redirect.github.com/apps/astro-factory)! - Fixes CSS Module HMR in dev when a component is rendered both with and without hydration on the same page. ### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>withastro/astro (astro)</summary>

### [`v7.4.2`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/blob/HEAD/packages/astro/CHANGELOG.md#742)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/compare/astro@7.4.1...astro@7.4.2)

##### Patch Changes

- [#​18430](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18430) [`dda9ec3`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/dda9ec395c89a1420abb3b8f88b5c7f1f385f82e) Thanks [@​Abhirup-99](https://redirect.github.com/Abhirup-99)! - Speeds up content sync with `experimental.collectionStorage: "chunked"` by computing each character's UTF-8 width from its code point instead of encoding every character through `TextEncoder`. On a store of \~44k entries this cuts the chunking step from about 60 seconds to well under a second, with byte-identical output.

- [#​18438](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18438) [`5e0eaa4`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/5e0eaa4415a9081efdaeb3d9af3717ce3226ad18) Thanks [@​astro-factory](https://redirect.github.com/apps/astro-factory)! - Fixes `astro dev` with `@astrojs/cloudflare` failing with ``Calling `require` for "node-fetch"`` when a server dependency such as `cross-fetch` requires `node-fetch`

- [#​18376](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18376) [`a4e201d`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/a4e201d79f19caa6bf4222f42167aeb602c066e6) Thanks [@​okxint](https://redirect.github.com/okxint)! - Fixes `astro dev` treating a stale lock file containing a Linux thread ID as a running Astro server. A successful process lookup with no matching PID now marks the lock as stale, preventing `astro dev stop` and `astro dev --force` from killing the unrelated process that owns the thread.

- [#​18467](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18467) [`d1fb7d3`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/d1fb7d36dad440c57d62b071e752ae220cca2baa) Thanks [@​astro-factory](https://redirect.github.com/apps/astro-factory)! - Fixes the `defineConfig()` types for `i18n.defaultLocale`, `i18n.fallback`, and `i18n.domains` so they accept a custom locale's `path` instead of its `codes`, matching how Astro validates and uses these values

- [#​18475](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18475) [`cf27e70`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/cf27e70a9057ce29ade2a8a843bd9275a696e9ab) Thanks [@​ematipico](https://redirect.github.com/ematipico)! - Bumps the minimum supported Node.js version to 22.23.4, which includes the fixes from the [October 2026 Node.js security releases](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/vulnerability/october-2026-security-releases)

  This is a patch release because the [Node.js support and upgrade policy](https://docs.astro.build/en/upgrade-astro/#nodejs-support-and-upgrade-policies) allows the Core team to raise the minimum Maintenance LTS version in a patch release when a disclosed and fixed Node.js security flaw affects Astro.

- [#​18451](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18451) [`7a0ba6f`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/7a0ba6f48ebae256a1ce49de4f1c62c009ff94e2) Thanks [@​DenisCDev](https://redirect.github.com/DenisCDev)! - Fixes `astro sync`, `astro check` and `astro build` replacing the optimized dependencies of a dev server running in the same project, which broke framework islands in that dev server until it was restarted with `--force`

- [#​18336](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18336) [`e943003`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/e943003259c3bb4d528d3d49c8ccd3eb8f84b8b5) Thanks [@​astro-factory](https://redirect.github.com/apps/astro-factory)! - Fixes inline styles in dev so that framework-transformed CSS is used, such as scoped styles and `v-bind()` in Vue single-file components

- [#​18399](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18399) [`829fc00`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/829fc00629ef715fc606b89c6e684ca93f9253b9) Thanks [@​astro-factory](https://redirect.github.com/apps/astro-factory)! - Fixes a dev server error (`Could not find server component name`) for a `server:defer` island that imports `astro:actions` or `astro:config/server`, when its page was not the first island page loaded after starting the server

- [#​18330](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18330) [`4db9e0d`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/4db9e0d1e6a54c2300b96a0ff0cfaf5c188cecda) Thanks [@​Samuteg](https://redirect.github.com/Samuteg)! - Fixes the `astro:env/server` virtual module being generated with invalid JS in dev when any environment variable contains `$` replacement patterns (`` $` ``, `$&`, `$'`, `$1`, …). The inlined env JSON was passed as a string to `String.replace`, so e.g. the `KITTY_PUBLIC_KEY` value set by default in Kitty terminals corrupted the module and broke dev with `Failed to parse source for import analysis`

- Updated dependencies \[[`cf27e70`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/cf27e70a9057ce29ade2a8a843bd9275a696e9ab)]:
  - [@​astrojs/telemetry](https://redirect.github.com/astrojs/telemetry)@3.4.1
  - [@​astrojs/markdown-satteri](https://redirect.github.com/astrojs/markdown-satteri)@0.4.5

##### Patch Changes

- [#​18559](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18559) [`10dae2f`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/10dae2f31486cc0a6a04d1f3d7f5ab7fa8889b30) Thanks [@​astro-factory](https://redirect.github.com/apps/astro-factory)! - Fixes `import.meta.env` values containing `$` sequences (such as `$$` or `$&`) being corrupted in `astro build` when server code reads the `import.meta.env` object directly, for example with `const { MY_SECRET } = import.meta.env`

These requests now return a `400`, the same as a path that is encoded too many times.

- [#​18520](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18520) [`e023aba`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/e023abac912d7cb6af2b9fb5107ef5dabc667096) Thanks [@​matthewp](https://redirect.github.com/matthewp)! - Makes rendering of string tag names stricter and consistent across `.astro` dynamic tags, JSX, and MDX. Only the leading part of the string that is a valid element name is rendered, so characters such as `/` or `=` can no longer change the generated markup. A string that does not start with a valid element name (for example `'!--'` or `''`) now throws an error instead of producing invalid HTML.

- [`7da442b`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/7da442bb286e0c29e1c9e1add6727b7cbf434f1a) Thanks [@​matthewp](https://redirect.github.com/matthewp)! - Fixes the image endpoint treating directories whose names differ only by letter case as being inside the build output directory on case-sensitive filesystems

### [`v7.4.6`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/blob/HEAD/packages/astro/CHANGELOG.md#746)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/compare/astro@7.4.5...astro@7.4.6)

##### Patch Changes

- [#​18565](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18565) [`cd09986`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/cd0998612eb9f48946991479d68590a1407ee5e0) Thanks [@​praveen-kumary](https://redirect.github.com/praveen-kumary)! - Avoids attributing client-only components or scripts to unrelated pages importing `astro:i18n` by bounding top-level page graph traversal at virtual page entries

- [#​18608](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18608) [`babd96d`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/babd96d1f16b8ea5a699693fb725a759d9fa03de) Thanks [@​umeraamir69](https://redirect.github.com/umeraamir69)! - Fixes an extra page reload on the first page load after starting `astro dev` without an existing `.astro` directory

- [#​18589](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18589) [`402c0fa`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/402c0fae01d251c97298c255804008ff566802f9) Thanks [@​astro-factory](https://redirect.github.com/apps/astro-factory)! - Fixes `astro check` exiting with code 0 when `@astrojs/check` or `typescript` is not installed. The command now exits with code 1 so CI fails instead of silently skipping type checking.

- [#​18503](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18503) [`54fcdd5`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/54fcdd5dedc982a77f1590e26247d57dd1802da9) Thanks [@​SwastikTripathi](https://redirect.github.com/SwastikTripathi)! - Preserves the last-modified date of cached font files and unchanged public files when copying them into the build output. Public-file timestamp preservation respects the resolved public-directory configuration, follows source symlinks, and avoids backdating files overwritten by build plugins.

- [#​18605](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18605) [`76cd239`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/76cd2398642bd77b61b9880dcfc7b78d513cb048) Thanks [@​astro-factory](https://redirect.github.com/apps/astro-factory)! - Fixes the `glob()` loader adding files from a folder excluded with a negation pattern such as `!_docs` when they change during `astro dev`

- [#​18432](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18432) [`ed60d82`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/ed60d82935d5768c3fcf67ce508e1f4edbfe25d6) Thanks [@​alexmv](https://redirect.github.com/alexmv)! - Improves the `MissingSharp` error to include the reason Sharp failed to load, such as its prebuilt binaries not supporting the current CPU

- [#​18474](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18474) [`59543c3`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/59543c3ad52e7141bcd6365cd70e8b51f18ccbd4) Thanks [@​miottid](https://redirect.github.com/miottid)! - Fixes i18n fallback for on-demand rendered pages. A locale-prefixed request for a page that only exists in the fallback locale (for example `/de/about` with `fallback: { de: 'en' }`) was answered with status `302` and no `Location` header. Such requests are now rewritten or redirected to the fallback locale according to `i18n.routing.fallbackType`, including encoded paths and sites with a configured `base`. Query strings are preserved, and explicit page statuses and redirects are left unchanged.

- [#​18541](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18541) [`cfa2d2b`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/cfa2d2b9e36ad610f6e7c27643e9157be3584a79) Thanks [@​ump45nose](https://redirect.github.com/ump45nose)! - Fixes `matchAllRoutes` to consider `fallbackRoutes`, matching `matchRoute` and the production router. Dev-server i18n fallback requests now resolve to the source route's metadata instead of the 404 route, and SSR-only fallback candidates can fall through the prerender handler.

- [#​18602](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18602) [`d856064`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/d8560645033aac84fe61d4f4b3462f55a9d2eb89) Thanks [@​astro-factory](https://redirect.github.com/apps/astro-factory)! - Fixes `astro check` losing the end of its output, including the `Result` summary, when stdout is piped to a slow reader. When the reader closes the pipe early, for example `astro check | head`, `astro check` now exits with code 1 instead of crashing with an `EPIPE` stack trace.

- [#​18574](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18574) [`da0f149`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/da0f149de58001fa5564d083acbae34e7b4a1b1f) Thanks [@​astro-factory](https://redirect.github.com/apps/astro-factory)! - Fixes an unnecessary full page reload in `astro dev` when a content loader calls `store.clear()` or `store.delete()` and the content store has no asset imports

- [#​18570](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18570) [`e71c038`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/e71c038f31194280b44515bf53cf449a5313baf9) Thanks [@​astro-factory](https://redirect.github.com/apps/astro-factory)! - Fixes pages using `<ClientRouter />` briefly showing the top of the page on reload before jumping back to the previous scroll position. Full reloads now use the browser's native scroll restoration.

- [#​18531](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18531) [`f75553b`](https://redirect.github.com/withastro/astro/commit/f75553b8bbe6cb9b72d8fda0059198ab3330f089) Thanks [@​praveen-kumary](https://redirect.github.com/praveen-kumary)! - Fixes an unhandled `TypeError: Cannot convert undefined or null to object` when calling `route.generate()` without arguments on static routes

title: feat(pricing): link the Catena Pro and Catena Business checkouts from the pricing matrix
body:
Needs contracts on the same branch: it imports @catenahq/contracts/pricing/checkout.json.

Cause: ops issue 471. The pricing matrix's CTA row had Get started (Community) and Talk to us (Business), and nothing for Catena Pro. No column linked a checkout.

The Catena Pro and Catena Business columns get a Subscribe button to the edition's Polar checkout with ?locale=<page locale> (Polar checkout links accept locale: https://polar.sh/docs/features/checkout/links). Catena Business keeps Talk to us below it, with a spacing rule for the stacked buttons. src/i18n/{en,fr}/common.json: home.pricing_matrix.subscribe (Subscribe / S'abonner). title: feat(home): name automatic firewall reconciliation as a feature
body:
Closes catenahq/ops#430.

## Change

- `src/i18n/{en,fr}/common.json`, card `home.features.items.secure_connections`: "Automatic firewall reconciliation opens the ports Catena and your apps declare, closes them when an app is removed, and re-checks the rules every five minutes to put back any that went missing." The FR card says the same in Quebec French.
- New pricing-matrix row `connectivity.firewall_reconciliation`, "Automatic firewall reconciliation" / "Réconciliation automatique du pare-feu", marked yes in Community, Catena Pro and Catena Business. The row is listed in `src/components/PricingMatrix.astro` (groups list, line 44 only). This stays clear of PR 103's lines, and `git merge-tree` with PR 103's head merges cleanly.

## Each claim, checked against the code

- **Community edition:** the feature grid row `networking` is CE. The timer runs on every host: catena-admin `payload/lanes/systemd/catena-public-ports.timer` says so, and catena-ce `ansible/reconcile/roles/public_ports/tasks/main.yml` turns it on with no licence condition.
- **Opens the declared ports:** the rule plan is built from the infra fragments in `/etc/catena/public-ports.d` plus the `vps.expose.*` labels (catena-admin `payload/lanes/catena-public-ports.py:424-449`, `payload/lib/public_ports.py:516`). ufw denies incoming connections by default (catena-ce `ansible/bootstrap/roles/common/tasks/main.yml:409`).
- **Closes them when an app is removed:** each pass deletes rules that are in the applied state but no longer in the plan (`catena-public-ports.py:439-446`). A service remove event starts a pass after 5 s (`payload/lanes/catena-app-events.py:20-29`). Docker drops a published port when its container stops. The bench already asserts this in `host_network_app_ports`, stage 7.
- **Re-checks every five minutes and puts missing rules back:** the timer has `OnUnitActiveSec=5min`. Every pass adds each planned ufw rule again (`catena-public-ports.py:280-294`). DOCKER-USER guards are checked with `iptables -C` and appended again when missing (`catena-public-ports.py:347-378`).
- **Not claimed:** that only declared ports are open. A port an app publishes without a label is opened by Docker and is only a K12 warning; the deploy is refused only on errors (catena-admin `payload/engines/applint/catena.go:784-798`, `payload/engines/apps/check.go:29`). Rules added by hand outside the registry are not removed either.

## Ran

- `npm run test:i18n` (parity ok, en=283 fr=283), `check-unicode.mjs`, `check-prose.mjs` (clean, plus one advisory warning; this change adds no comments), `npm ci`, `npm run check` (0 errors), `npm run build` (21 pages; the built EN and FR home pages carry the new text).
- `check-repo-rules.mjs` fails only on the tracked `.agent/` files, which come off before the merge.
- The ops pricing generator agrees with the change once the features.yml line below is added: `CATENAHQ_WEBSITE_ROOT=<website> python3 automation/operator-tools/generate-pricing-matrix.py --check` gave rc 0, and the new row is reported as owned.
- No unit test: this is copy only, and the i18n parity gate covers the new keys.

## Reserved path (ops, its own commit)

ops `automation/audit/features.yml`, feature `id: networking`, under `pricing.rows`, after `connectivity.app_tunnel: community`, add:

```
        connectivity.firewall_reconciliation: community
```

Without it, `generate-pricing-matrix.py` reports the row as unowned and hand-maintained.

Issue: https://github.com/catenahq/ops/issues/430
